start_condition: Complete E3a-Z and candidate validation diagnostics before scheduling this trio

architecture.encoders: existing two full-heterograph Edge encoders, hidden64, flow/packet pooling
architecture.z: separate Linear(64,8) representation projections, not directly supervised class logits

loss.reduction: mean over batch for each CE; average the two branch CE values

C_global.s_scope: one scalar shared by all samples/classes

B_dynamic.initialization: final gate Linear weight and bias zero; all samples start at 0.5
B_dynamic.input_semantics: representation statistics, not supervised/calibrated confidence features
B_dynamic.gradient_check: nonzero final-layer gradient and actual update; zero upstream gradient on first equal-init step allowed; verify gate learns in real probe

controls.paired_initialization: clone all common encoder/projection/H tensors from same initial state; verify hashes; restore RNG before loaders and optimizer; do not claim equal fusion parameter counts
controls.data_order: same existing TrainBatches implementation per seed; record train_order_sha256 each epoch

decision.seed42: exploratory screening; compare B-A and B-C validation Macro in percentage points plus class precision/recall/F1 and fusion failures
decision.candidate_for_confirmation: B exceeds both A and C on validation and diagnostics reproduce; a small single-seed lead only nominates confirmation, never justifies adding modules
decision.confirmation: freeze config first; paired seed43/44 plus disclosed exploratory seed42; report each seed difference, mean difference and sample standard deviation; no every-seed-win requirement or three-seed significance claim
decision.no_dynamic_gain: If B is close to C or gains are inconsistent, do not claim sample adaptation; retain simple fusion and pause architecture expansion
decision.followup_ablation: Only for promising results, remove branch supervision from candidate and matching simple-fusion control
decision.cost: report total/trainable/active parameters and forward cost under matched batch/runtime; shared-device timings are descriptive
decision.test: freeze all candidate/config choices before unified test evaluation; disclose prior known test results
